_doc.purpose: Shared conformance corpus for the model-literal lint (t/3656, SO condition 4 of t/3557). Both implementations consume it and must agree: lib/ai-config/modelLiteralLint.ts (TS) and tests/ModelLiteralLint.Tests.ps1 (PS). Turns 'same predicate' from a claim into a test.
_doc.scope: Tests the RESOLUTION predicate + MARKER-parsing, NOT extraction. The two extraction regexes differ by design (TS scans all backend-prefixed literals; PS scans -Model/$*Model*= binding positions only — t/3560) and are deliberately NOT forced to agree. What both CLAIM is identical — given an extracted id + its co-located marker + the registry, is it an offender? — is what this corpus pins.

layers.resolution: Wireable today. Drives the pure set-membership predicate (TS lintModelLiterals / PS Get-ModelLintOffenders): id in registeredIds -> pass, else fail. Cases assume an already-extractable id.
layers.marker: PROVISIONAL — the t/3557 condition-1 future contract. Neither impl parses the typed marker grammar yet (both do plain line-contains today). Consumers MUST visibly SKIP these rows (Set-ItResult -Skipped / it.skip) with reason 'pending t/3557 cond-1', not silently pass, so staging is visible. Flip Skipped->asserted as cond-1 lands.
layers.registry: Guard/loader-level, NOT the pure predicate. expect:'error' means the registry-load guard fires (PS: the @(ValidIds).Count -gt 0 false-green guard; TS: the caller's equivalent), distinct from 'unregistered literal'. Do NOT wire these into the pure predicate on either side.

markerGrammar.status: PROVISIONAL — ratified by t/3557 condition 1 (not yet landed). Until locked there, the marker rows below are provisional data. Both impls must parse this grammar IDENTICALLY or the corpus cannot arbitrate; that identical parse is cond-1's deliverable.

forms.model-lint:allow-pin <reason>: PASS — deliberate pin of an intentionally-unregistered id (raw provider id, embedding/reranker/TTS model). Reason required.
forms.model-lint:allow-external <reason>: PASS — external/BYOK id legitimately absent from the curated registry (e.g. azure deployment). Reason required.
forms.model-lint:allow (bare): FAIL — deprecated ambiguous form; cond-1 requires a typed marker + reason.
forms.allow-pin on a registered id: FAIL — contradiction: a pin claiming to pin something that IS in the registry (never a pin).

fields.name: unique case id
fields.id: the model-id literal under test (already extracted)
fields.marker: null, or the full co-located marker comment text
fields.registeredIds: the registered model-id set for this case (self-contained; not the live ai-models.json)
fields.reason: one-line rationale so a failure is self-explaining

cases.name: resolution-registered-passes
cases.reason: literal resolves to a registered models[].id

cases.name: resolution-registered-passes-other-backend
cases.reason: a second registered id on a different backend — the predicate is backend-agnostic set membership

cases.name: resolution-unregistered-fails
cases.reason: well-formed but unregistered id — the core drift this gate exists to catch

cases.name: resolution-near-miss-dated-variant-fails
cases.reason: near-miss of the registered ollama-gemma4-e4b-it-q4-k-m — close but not registered; the modelRouter.ts:105 class the gate actually caught

cases.name: resolution-retired-model-fails
cases.reason: a once-valid id dropped by a registry migration — passes locally, latent P0 (Invoke-AIApi returns null before the parser runs)

cases.name: marker-allow-pin-suppresses
cases.marker: model-lint:allow-pin embedding model, not an LLM selection
cases.reason: deliberate pin of an intentionally-unregistered id with a reason — the legitimate exemption

cases.name: marker-allow-external-suppresses
cases.marker: model-lint:allow-external BYOK azure deployment id, not in the curated registry
cases.reason: external/BYOK id legitimately absent from the curated set, exempted with a reason

cases.name: marker-bare-allow-deprecated-fails
cases.reason: bare allow with no typed sub-form and no reason — cond-1 deprecates the ambiguous form; it must not survive

cases.name: marker-pin-on-registered-contradiction-fails
cases.marker: model-lint:allow-pin pinning a model that is actually registered
cases.reason: contradiction — a pin marker on an id that IS registered; the pin is spurious/misleading and must be flagged, not silently honoured

cases.name: registry-empty-is-error-not-unregistered
cases.reason: an empty registered set means the registry failed to load — the guard must fire (distinct outcome), NOT treat every literal as unregistered and flood offenders

cases.name: registry-unreadable-is-error-not-unregistered
cases.reason: the registry file could not be read — the loader/guard must fail loudly, distinct from 'unregistered literal'
